systems.system: Projet de couverture nationale en infrastructures de télécommunications (PCN)
systems.owner: State; assets of phases 1-2 made available to Congo Telecom in usufruct, to be transferred to it by decree

note: Council of Ministers 2026-05-06 transfers PCN phase 1-3 assets (FCFA 143.9bn) to Congo Telecom, phase 3 under way, but never says fibre, backbone or regions connected, so no backbone fact.
